artworks.title: An Alpine Valley with Trees and Boulders
artworks.medium: watercolor, gouache and black chalk, with pen and black ink, over traces of graphite on  wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke

artworks.title: A Woman in Profile and a Pollard Tree in Bloom
artworks.medium: conte crayon with stumping on brown paper
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile portrait of a person, capturing their upper body and head. The individual is positioned in profile, facing left. They have distinct facial features with a prominent nose and a defined jawline. Their hair is styled in curls and pulled back neatly. The person is dressed in what appears to be period clothing, with a high-collared shirt that has some detailing. They are wearing a single earring, which is visible on the ear facing the viewer. The background consists of a detailed sketch of trees with branches and leaves, adding a textured element to the composition. The image has an overall classic, drawn appearance with elements annotated, including dates and text on the piece.

artworks.title: Old Man with a Helmet
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man from the waist up, seated slightly to the side but facing forward. His facial features are prominent with deep-set eyes, a furrowed brow, and a long, full beard. His hair is curly and voluminous. He is dressed in a thick fur-like garment that envelops his shoulders and chest. In his right hand, he holds a piece of fabric or hat with a decorative band. There is a strap across his chest with a round buckle. The background is dark and textured.

artworks.title: Saint Wenzel Cooking Hosts as Two Youths Press Wine
artworks.medium: black chalk with blue and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval kitchen scene with figures engaged in various culinary tasks. The image depicts a room with stone walls and a checkered floor, serving as the setting for a busy kitchen. Shelves hold jars and sacks, while barrels are stacked against the wall. On the left, a figure in flowing robes sits on a stool, using a pair of tongs to handle round objects on a cylindrical cooking stove. The central figure stands at a large wooden contraption, possibly a press, while another figure on the right kneels beside a set of barrels, attending to a container. The scene captures the activity and tools typical of a historical kitchen.

artworks.title: Wooded Cliffs along a Riverbank
artworks.medium: watercolor over black chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a winding stream. The horizon is in the middle distance where the land meets the sky. On the rocky terrain, trees spread out, while an arch bridge is visible to the right. The colors are muted, with shades of gray, green, and brown dominating the palette.

artworks.title: Cannon by a Bulwark
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on brown paper
artworks.description: The image shows a large, dark cannon outdoors surrounded by wooden supports and sandy terrain, with coils of rope and a small wooden barrel in the foreground.

artworks.title: Bust of a Man in an Extravagant Costume
artworks.artist: French 16th Century after René Boyvin or Pierre Milan
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a profile view of a creative artistic representation of a person's head and shoulders facing left. The facial features are made from a collection of objects resembling various natural and artistic elements, such as grapes forming the beard and other botanical and architectural motifs creating the hair and facial structure. The hair is long and wavy, made from vines and leaves. The person wears an elaborate sculptural garment with decorative elements like flaps and buttons. There is no visible traditional jewelry. The background is plain, highlighting the figure's complexity and imaginative construction.

artworks.title: David Playing the Harp before Saul
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to platemark): 25.4 x 18.2 cm (10 x 7 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of multiple figures. The main focus is on two primary characters positioned in the foreground. The seated figure on the right is shown from the knees up, seated in a chair, leaning forward while holding a staff. He has a beard, wears a turban, and his garment is lined with fur. To his left, a standing man is playing a harp. He has short, straight hair and wears a tunic and boots. Other figures can be seen partially, only showing their upper torsos and faces. The background includes architectural columns adorned with human and mythical figures, alongside hanging bead-like ornaments.

artworks.title: Musculorum Tabula IV
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper with accompanying leaf of descriptive text from the later English edition
artworks.description: The image shows a full human skeleton standing upright with both arms extended outward. The background features a large rhinoceros standing behind the skeleton, lush vegetation, textured trees, and a stone wall. The composition emphasizes anatomical detail and the interaction of the skeleton with its surroundings.

artworks.title: The Fine Musetioners
artworks.medium: chalk manner with applied gold leaf on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in honor of Margaret Morgan Grasselli
artworks.description: The image shows two women seated closely together on a chair or couch. The woman on the left leans towards the other, with her right arm resting on the back of the chair. She has brown hair in an updo. The other woman sits upright, holding an open book. Her hair is light brown or blonde with curls and a floral ornament. Both women have delicate features. They wear period-appropriate dresses: the first woman in a yellow-gold gown with a sash, and the second woman in a white gown with a blue wrap. The woman with lighter hair wears pearls. The background is dark, and the image is framed with blue and gold patterns.

artworks.title: Three Scenes on the Road to Calvary
artworks.medium: 3 woodcuts from the set of 40 on laid paper [uncut proofs]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a sequence of three scenes depicting a journey with a cross. The drawing shows three individual yet related scenes within rectangular frames, akin to a triptych-style work. Each scene captures various stages of a journey marked by a large cross. The scenes show figures with gestures and tools that imply crafting or construction work. The figures are rendered in a detailed monochromatic style, utilizing high contrast between black outlines and white space to highlight different textures and details of the crossed figure's garments and expressions. This is in the style of a classical woodcut, which completes a historic or religious narrative through meticulous line work and composition.

artworks.title: Seven Men in Antique Dress
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures engaged in an event. The image features a group of figures, with the central one posed dynamically, muscles defined, and with an outstretched arm as if in motion. Surrounding them are more figures, each contributing to the scene’s intensity, with expressive lines and shading. The style uses bold, fluid lines to capture movement and emotion.

artworks.title: Architectural Fantasy of a Magnificent Ancient Mausoleum
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink over graphite, with gray and black wash and watercolor on thin wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a slightly elevated view of a grand architectural scene. The horizon is low, emphasizing the architectural structures. In the center is a large amphitheater with multiple tiers and ornate decorations. The architecture features classical style, meticulously rendered columns and arches. The color palette is soft, dominated by beige and gray tones. The sky has delicate brushstrokes creating soft clouds. Beyond the amphitheater are classical buildings, archways, and gentle hills in the background.

artworks.title: Herodias and Salome
artworks.medium: working proof state of line block of chiaroscuro woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a half-length depiction of two figures. The figure on the left is positioned slightly in profile, facing the right, with their head turned toward the other person. This figure has long, wavy hair partially covered by a veil, featuring delicate facial features with eyes downcast. The figure on the right is facing forward, looking directly ahead with an expressionless face. This figure has curly hair adorned with a large, rounded headdress or possibly a headband. Both individuals are dressed in draped, flowing garments with long sleeves that have slightly gathered cuffs. In their hands, they hold a platter, which supports a lifelike head with cascading hair and closed eyes. The background is plain and unembellished, accentuating the detailed linework of the figures and the object they carry.

artworks.title: Old Man Wearing a Turban Ornamented with Fur, Facing Right
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a head-and-shoulders portrait of a person facing right in profile. The individual has a prominent nose, defined cheekbones, and appears focused. Their hair is styled intricately with large curls or a hat with feathers. They wear a garment that drapes over the shoulders in loose lines, suggesting a light fabric. No jewelry or objects are visible. The background has fine lines, emphasizing the subject. There is text above the figure that reads "Casti(lion)le Seriozes" with initials. The artwork features a fluid, expressive line technique typical of etching.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Middle-Aged Man
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 14.2 x 8.9 cm (5 9/16 x 3 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a person facing the viewer directly. The facial features include a mustache, small and narrow eyes, and a subtle expression. The hair is short and neatly combed. The subject is wearing a garment with a high collar adorned with intricate patterns. There are no visible accessories or objects being held. The background is plain with no distinguishable features.

artworks.title: Resting
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This painting shows a person leaning against a tree trunk. They face the left, and we see them from the side. The person has light skin and short brown hair, and they are wearing a yellow hat with red accents, a dark blue shirt or blouse, and a light pink skirt with some blue stripes. The person is looking down at a piece of paper or a small book that they hold in their hands. They are leaning against the large trunk of a light gray tree that stands on top of a pale-yellow hill with patches of light green, yellow ochre, dark blue, and dark red, giving the impression of dirt with patches of grass. The background is dark blue, with the faint brown outlines of more trees. The brushstrokes in the painting are wide and smooth, with some applying paint very thickly, and some applying paint in thin, translucent strokes.

artworks.title: Spanish Church Interior
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior of a dimly lit, arched space. The painting features an arched interior with subdued lighting, casting deep shadows on the surfaces. The focus is on an altar or prominent structure within the arched recess, emphasized by warm hues of red and yellow. The floor in the foreground transitions from darker shades to a lighter blend of blues and browns. The overall atmosphere is somber and contemplative, capturing the quiet reverence of a sacred space.

artworks.title: Sir Neville Wilkinson on the Steps of the Palladian Bridge at Wilton House
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper

artworks.title: Frascati, Architectural Study
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper mounted on board
artworks.description: The image displays a classical architectural structure seen from a slightly elevated point, with two large columns dominating the right side. The columns are in warm tones of beige and ochre. A stretch of greenery and dark, blurred trees are visible in the background, alongside a hint of a dusky sky. Loose and fluid brushstrokes give a soft, dreamy quality to the scene. The color palette includes earthy tones, hints of green, and muted blues, creating a serene atmosphere. The background suggests an open landscape beyond the structure.

artworks.title: The Calle della Rosa with the Monte di Pietà, Venice
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper

artworks.title: The Piazzetta
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper mounted to board
artworks.description: This painting shows a scene of a city seen across a canal. Gondolas are on the water closest to us, with a large building on the left and a tall column on the right, behind which are more buildings, including one with a dome. The painting style is loose and fluid, capturing light and shadow with soft brushstrokes and a color palette of pale blues, pinks, yellows, greens, and creams. Darker brushstrokes give the impression of people walking below the buildings.

artworks.title: Cairo
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This painting shows a sloping wall made of large stones on the right, leading up past the top of the painting. On the left side, a mosque with two minarets is silhouetted against a bright sky in the distance, surrounded by more buildings. The ground and stones are in shades of gray, cream, pale brown, and pale pink, with dark blue shadows. The scene is depicted using loose, fluid brushstrokes.

artworks.title: Sunlit Wall Under a Tree
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a sunlit street scene. On the left side of the gray street is a tall brown building. On the right side, a large tree with green leaves is partially obscured by a gray wall. The sun shines from above through the leaves, casting shadows on the street below. The painting features loose, fluid brushstrokes, and the colors are soft, muted earth tones.
